# Code Anchors: Hub Settings Layer

- `libs/delivery-config/src/hub.ts` — the layer itself: guarded on the checkout declaring a workspace, merges the hub's own settings over the manifest defaults, keeps publishing keys only, and drops an unreadable hub settings file on its own.
- `libs/delivery-config/src/settings.ts` — the one settings reader the layer reuses for the hub checkout.
- `libs/delivery-config/src/keys.ts` — the catalogue row marking the test command repository-specific.
- `libs/delivery-config/src/resolve.ts` — the precedence chain that places this layer between repo settings and the built-in.
- `libs/delivery-config/src/write.ts` — the writer that skips every key this layer supplies.
- `libs/workspace/src/resolve.ts` — the workspace resolver whose located hub root this layer reads from.
- `libs/workspace/src/manifest.ts` — carries the workspace-wide defaults that form the lower half of this layer.
- `libs/delivery-config/src/hub-inheritance.spec.ts` — covers inheritance, member override, hub-own-over-manifest order, the test-command exclusion, the silent fallbacks, and the no-copy write-back.
- `.nexus/config/templates/workspace-template.yml` — documents the hub's own settings reaching members above the manifest defaults.
- `CHANGELOG.md` — the release note telling leads to delete copied hub values from each member.
